answer: Gate entry with a funding-cluster escalating bond behind a velvet rope: a first identity locks 50 POA for 14 days, while each extra identity traced to the same funding cluster must lock double the last: 100, then 200, then 400 POA, so ten fakes tie up 51,150 POA instead of 500. Like a lagoon with a narrow inlet, each cluster may register only one identity per epoch. The kernel of the check is on-chain funding tracing: attestors verify the lock, its source cluster, and its age before countersigning, and early withdrawal forfeits 25% of the bond.
